subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete
stimulus: sentence. There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. In the present day, cricket is the i. both the players and spectators alike. b . It is also the most ii. all over the world. c. This game is played between two iii. full of thrill and excitement. d. Its popularity is increasing day by day iv. interesting and enjoyable game in Bangladesh. e. The game gives pleasure to v. discipline and promptness. vi. most popular game all over the world. vii. teams consisting of 22 players.
guide_solution: (a) + vi) : In the present day, cricket is the most popular game all over the world. (b + iv) : It is also the most interesting and enjoyable game in Bangladesh. (c + vii) : This game is played between two teams consisting of 22 players. (d + ii) : Its popularity is increasing day by day all over the world. 22 (e + i) : The game gives pleasure to both the players and spectators alike.
